other_conditions: Family must be living in a Kutcha house in villages
Priority is given to widow women, separate female, physically disabled persons, and unmarried girls (age more than 35 years)
Family must have a maximum of 15 Bigha of land in a village
Family must have a maximum of 3 Katha of land in small towns or 1.5 Katha of land in Kamrup Metro
benefits_summary: Provides Rs 1000 per month (including subsidies for medicines, pulses, sugar, fruits & vegetables) via Direct Benefit Transfer to eligible women households.
